topic: mindset: boring consistency beats exciting bursts (90 days)
image_subtext: 90 days of daily posting will change your life. Motivation won't.

captions.x:
Nobody goes viral on day 1.

But post daily for 90 days and watch:

→ Your skills compound
→ Your audience compounds
→ Your income follows

Motivation starts. Discipline finishes.
